# Night Sky (`nightSky`)

The Milky Way wheeling over a ridge, with tonight's moon phase.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: location
- Cost: heavy (~6.7 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Night Sky

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Rotation | slider | 0 … 4 | 1 |
| `milky` | Milky Way | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 1 |
| `stars` | Stars | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 1 |
| `moon` | Moon | slider | 0 … 1 | 1 |
| `meteors` | Meteors | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.4 |
